breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeated the user's incorrect pairing of Hv = 0.3 m with water at 100°C without any correction. It should have either corrected Hv to ~10.3 m for 100°C water, or adjusted the temperature to ~25°C where Hv ≈ 0.3 m is physically accurate. The inconsistency was not identified or resolved.
